title: GT Arena Motocross
seo_title: GT Arena Motocross at Cowan Civic Center, Lebanon MO
description: GT Arena Motocross is the General Tire Arenacross, an indoor event with head-to-head racing and non-stop action featuring professional and amateur races. It is planned for December 11 and 12, 2026, and the listing for Saturday, December 12 runs from 7:00 PM to 11:45 PM at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street, Lebanon, MO.
